examples.ko: 시골 길에서 당나귀가 짐을 끌고 있었어요.
examples.en: A donkey was pulling a load on a country road.
The kids rode a donkey and took photos.
A donkey is smaller in body than a horse.

examples.ko: 동화 속 당나귀에게 이름을 붙여 줬어요.
examples.en: I gave the donkey in the fairy tale a name.

examples.ko: 이솝 이야기에는 사자 가죽을 쓴 당나귀가 나와요.
examples.en: In Aesop's fables, there is a donkey wearing a lion's skin.
I have a friend who is stubborn like a donkey.

explain: '임금님 귀는 당나귀 귀'라는 옛이야기로 한국 사람에게 친숙한 동물이에요. 말보다 몸집이 작고 짐을 나르는 모습을 먼저 떠올려요. 한국 시골에서는 보기 어려워서 책이나 여행에서 만나는 동물이에요.
explain_en: Koreans know this animal from the old tale '임금님 귀는 당나귀 귀'. It is smaller than a horse, and people first picture it carrying loads. It is hard to see in the Korean countryside, so people meet it in books or on trips.

en: to breed; to raise; to rear

examples.en: My grandfather raises chickens in the countryside.
They are raising cattle on this farm.
It is hard to raise large animals at home.

examples.ko: 동물원은 멸종 위기 동물을 사육해서 지켜요.
examples.en: Zoos protect endangered animals by breeding them.

examples.ko: 사육한 지 오 년 된 말이에요.
examples.en: It is a horse that has been raised for five years.

examples.ko: 좁은 곳에서 사육하면 동물이 스트레스를 받아요.
examples.en: If you raise animals in cramped places, they get stressed.

explain: '사육하다'는 농장이나 동물원에서 동물을 먹여 기르는 일이에요. 집에서 강아지나 고양이를 기를 때는 '키우다'가 자연스럽고, '사육하다'를 쓰면 가축처럼 느껴져요. 식물을 기를 때는 '재배하다'를 써요.
explain_en: 사육하다 is feeding and raising animals on a farm or in a zoo. For a pet dog or cat at home, '키우다' is natural, and 사육하다 would make it sound like livestock. For plants use '재배하다'.

examples.en: It's a blanket light as a feather, so it's warm and comfortable.
A single bird feather had fallen on the floor.

examples.ko: 새털이 빠진 자리에 새로 털이 나요.
examples.en: New feathers grow where the old ones fell out.

examples.ko: 새털로 만든 장식이 인형 머리에 붙어 있어요.
examples.en: A decoration made of feathers is stuck on the doll's head.

examples.ko: 아이가 새털을 주워 책 사이에 끼웠어요.
examples.en: The child picked up a feather and tucked it between the pages of a book.
Feathers are light, so the wind blows them away easily.

explain: 새의 가는 털을 말하는데, 큰 날개 깃털은 '깃털'이라고 더 자주 해요. 그래서 '새털'은 가볍고 부드러운 느낌을 말할 때 자주 어울려요.

phrases.example: 아직 시간은 새털같이 많으니까 서두르지 마세요.
phrases.en: We still have plenty of time, so don't rush.
phrases.nuance_ko: 주로 '날', '시간'과 함께 써서 앞으로 남은 날이 아주 많다는 뜻이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: Usually used with '날' or '시간' to mean there are very many days or much time still ahead.

explain_en: It means a bird's fine feathers, while the larger wing feathers are more often called '깃털'. So '새털' fits best when you want to convey lightness or softness.

examples.en: I tried trout sashimi in Gangwon-do.
I went for a trout fishing experience.
Trout live in cold, clear water.
I caught a trout myself at the winter festival.
I squeezed lemon on the grilled trout and ate it.
My mother grilled a trout for me.

explain: 연어와 모양이 비슷하지만 송어는 주로 민물에서 길러 먹어요. 한국에서는 겨울 송어 축제와 '송어회'로 유명해요.
explain_en: It looks similar to salmon, but trout is mostly raised and eaten from fresh water. In Korea it is known for winter trout festivals and '송어회'.

examples.en: I saw an otter for the first time at the zoo.

examples.ko: 수달 한 마리가 물속에서 헤엄치고 있어요.
examples.en: An otter is swimming in the water.
Otters catch and eat fish.
In Korea, otters are a protected animal.
I got a cute otter doll as a present.
The otter is an animal that swims in clear rivers.

explain: 강과 하천에 사는 동물이에요. 바다에 사는 비슷한 동물은 '해달'이라고 불러서 서로 달라요. 한국에서는 천연기념물이라 뉴스에서 '수달 발견'처럼 나오기도 해요.
explain_en: An animal that lives in rivers and streams. The similar sea-dwelling animal is called '해달' (sea otter), so the two differ. In Korea it is a natural monument, so news sometimes reports '수달 발견' (otter sighted).

examples.en: When spring came, daffodils bloomed in the garden.

examples.ko: 노란 수선화 한 다발을 선물로 받았어요.
examples.en: I received a bunch of yellow daffodils as a gift.
I planted daffodil bulbs in a pot in the fall.

examples.ko: 꽃집에서 수선화를 사다가 책상에 꽂아 뒀어요.
examples.en: I bought daffodils at the flower shop and put them in a vase on my desk.

examples.ko: 제주도에는 수선화가 일찍 피어서 구경하러 갔어요.
examples.en: Daffodils bloom early on Jeju Island, so I went to see them.

examples.ko: 이 수선화 향기가 방 안에 가득해요.
examples.en: The scent of these daffodils fills the whole room.

explain: 봄꽃 이야기를 할 때 개나리, 튤립과 함께 자주 나와요. 물 '水(수)'와 신선 '仙(선)'이 들어간 꽃 이름이라 '옷을 고치는 수선'과는 관계가 없어요.
explain_en: It often appears in talk about spring flowers, along with '개나리' (forsythia) and '튤립' (tulip). It is a flower name and has nothing to do with '수선', meaning clothing alterations.

examples.en: A rooster crowed loudly at dawn.
Roosters are bigger than hens.
We raise a rooster in the yard.
A rooster climbed onto the roof.
I saw a rooster and hens at the farm.
Try waking up early like a rooster.

explain: 수탉은 수컷 닭이고 반대말은 '암탉'이에요. 암수를 가리지 않거나 고기를 말할 때는 그냥 '닭'이라고 해요. 닭의 울음소리는 '꼬끼오'라고 표현해요.
explain_en: 수탉 is a male chicken and its opposite is 암탉. When sex doesn't matter, or when speaking of the meat, people just say 닭. A rooster's crow is written as 꼬끼오.

examples.en: Santa Claus rides a sleigh pulled by reindeer.
Reindeer live in cold northern regions.
I saw a reindeer in person in Finland.
A reindeer has large antlers on its head.
The child drew a reindeer on the Christmas card.

examples.ko: 눈 덮인 숲에서 순록 떼가 걸어가고 있어요.
examples.en: A herd of reindeer is walking through the snowy forest.

explain: '순록'은 추운 지방에 사는 사슴이에요. 한국 사람들은 크리스마스 이야기 때문에 '루돌프'라는 이름과 함께 떠올려요. 한국의 산에서 보는 '사슴'과는 다른 동물이에요.
explain_en: '순록' is a deer that lives in cold regions. Because of the Christmas story, Koreans associate it with the name '루돌프'. It is different from the '사슴' seen in Korean mountains.

examples.en: Could there be life that came from outer space?

examples.ko: 그 영화는 외계 생명체와 친구가 되는 이야기예요.
examples.en: That movie is about becoming friends with an alien.
Scientists are searching for planets outside our solar system.
My younger brother believes aliens really exist.
The news said they heard a signal from outer space.
Children love stories about aliens.

explain: 외계는 지구 밖의 세계라는 뜻이라서 보통 '외계인', '외계 생명체'처럼 붙어서 나와요. '외계에서 온'처럼 단독으로도 쓰지만 합친 말이 더 많아요. 같이 알아 둘 말로 '우주'가 있어요.
explain_en: 외계 is the world outside Earth, and usually appears in compounds like 외계인 (alien) and 외계 생명체 (alien life form). It can stand alone, as in '외계에서 온', but compounds are more common. 우주 (universe) is a related word.

examples.ko: 할머니 집 뒤에 작은 텃밭이 있어요.
examples.en: There is a small vegetable plot behind my grandmother's house.
Every weekend I grow lettuce in my garden plot.
I watered the plot and pulled the weeds too.
The tomatoes in our garden plot have ripened red.

examples.ko: 아파트 옥상에 텃밭을 만든 사람도 있어요.
examples.en: Some people have even made a vegetable garden on an apartment rooftop.

examples.ko: 직접 기른 텃밭 채소라서 더 맛있어요.
examples.en: It tastes better because the vegetables come from my own plot.

explain: '밭'은 채소나 곡식을 키우는 땅 전체를 부르지만, '텃밭'은 집 가까이에 있는 작은 밭이에요. 팔려고 키우기보다 가족이 먹으려고 키우는 느낌이 있어서 '주말농장'과도 가까워요.
explain_en: '밭' covers any field, while '텃밭' is a small plot near the house. It suggests growing food for your own family rather than to sell, which is close to the idea of a '주말농장' (weekend farm).
